## Pull Request checklist

- **Target branch:** `main` (please open PRs targeting `main`)

### Type of change
- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] docs
- [ ] chore
- [ ] ci
- [ ] refactor

### Description
Provide a short summary of the change and why it was necessary. Mention any relevant issue numbers.

### Changes
- Bullet the important changes made in this PR.

### How to test / reproduce
1. Steps to set up environment (e.g., `pip install -r requirements.txt`).
2. Steps to run or reproduce the behavior (e.g., `python geraXls.py --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-01-03 --output out/ci_cotacoes.xlsx`).

### Checklist
- [ ] I have added/updated documentation (README, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) if needed
- [ ] The branch name follows convention (e.g., `feat/<description>`, `chore/<description>`)
- [ ] CI and smoke tests pass
- [ ] Changes are small and focused

### Reviewers / Notes
- Add suggested reviewers and any notes about deployment, migrations or breaking changes.

---
*Tip:* Keep PRs small and focused to make review fast. Merci! 🙏
